notes: Nothing here is won - the answers reduce it to browsing and buying in one small cute pink plaza - so this is Entertainment, and Free-Roam Showcase is the preset: Entertainment words world-open as a free-roam space browsed in no prescribed order, which is what a shop plaza is, and the decal displays are the content rather than an orientation aid, with the spawn oriented on the composed pink shot. Roleplay & Avatar Sim is named second because the subject genuinely is avatar customization, but I rejected its Dress Up preset since the answers ruled out a runway and preparation booths, and dropped social-hub too because they ruled out a hangout area. Dropped the preset's hidden collectibles for the same reason - there is nothing to find. I assumed without asking that players walk the plaza to reach the display boards rather than shopping from a menu, so this is an ordinary walkable P0 build and not a SET.
